rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary reports two identified labels with one occurrence each, matching the two identified_occurrences; candidate_biases contains one candidate and is kept separate from the identified summary.

evaluation_limitations: No frozen evaluation segment map was supplied, so four eligible reasoning segments were generated from the four decision points.
The actual retrieved passages and retrieval logs were not supplied; corpus fidelity cannot be scored.
This is a per-interview evaluation and does not support dataset-level significance, ranking, or causal claims.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had the tenant's general business type... I didn't have their SKU list yet. ... The two prior jobs I'd done for similar operators both landed at Class III, so I went with that pattern rather than waiting on the tenant's list.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant classified the tenant using category similarity to two prior 3PL clients instead of obtaining tenant-specific packaging data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I took the first density/area point that cleared the minimum... and ran with it rather than working through the other combinations.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant stopped at the first code-minimum-satisfying design point without comparing the available configuration-specific alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We've got two more retrofit jobs pending with this same owner... I recommended pulling the in-rack allowance to hit his number. ... I mentioned [the uncertainty] in passing but framed the removal as a reasonable trade-off.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The recommendation was influenced by preserving an ongoing owner relationship, while the classification-uncertainty risk was not fully surfaced.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I decided to do the full witnessed test anyway.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification deliberately leaves commissioning free of intentional bias; the participant followed the required full witnessed flow-test process.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_001 uses exact participant quotes from the commodity-classification episode and explicitly labels that episode.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The finding is correctly localized but names Confirmation bias rather than the hidden Stereotyping target. Its evidence overlaps the category-similarity mechanism substantially, but the explanation centers on confirmatory search rather than fully matching the hidden mechanism.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 uses exact participant quotes from the density/area-selection episode and describes the first selected point.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The finding is correctly localized and its mechanism fully captures stopping at the first minimally acceptable option, but the named label Anchoring bias is a near-neighbor taxonomy label rather than the hidden Satisficing label.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: cand_001 quotes the value-engineering episode exactly and identifies the pending owner projects and the downplayed uncertainty.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The candidate is not scored before the fourth threshold. If promoted, its proposed Motivated reasoning label would fail strict label matching, but its mechanism fully matches the hidden Incentive bias instance.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: The commissioning episode is an eligible negative segment and contains no RAG finding.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The participant selected the required full witnessed flow test despite schedule pressure; no hidden bias instance is present and none was predicted.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Commodity classification for the incoming 3PL tenant
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Category-based inference about tenant storage hazard substituted for case-specific inventory verification.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is a related but distinct construct. The observation emphasizes seeking or weighting confirmatory evidence, whereas the hidden target requires category-based generalization from similar prior tenants replacing tenant-specific verification.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding correctly captures reliance on prior similar clients, the absent SKU list, and failure to seek case-specific data, but its stated mechanism is confirmatory search rather than the full category-substitution mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is faithful to the interview and the episode localization is exact; the causal interpretation overcommits to Confirmation bias and does not establish the hidden label.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: NFPA density/area point selection for the rack sprinkler design
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Premature stopping at the first code-minimum-satisfying design option instead of comparing configuration-specific alternatives.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a near-neighbor label. The evidence does not require an initial numeric anchor; the hidden construct is stopping once the first technically adequate option was found.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: Despite the anchoring terminology, the finding explicitly states that the participant chose the first code-minimum point and did not compare available alternatives, fully matching the hidden mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotes and sequence are accurate. The later AHJ note is used as corroboration rather than as proof, and the low confidence appropriately acknowledges the legitimate code-minimum and schedule-pressure interpretation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Value-engineering recommendation on the in-rack sprinkler allowance
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Recommendation shaped by preserving an ongoing multi-project client relationship rather than neutral risk weighing.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Motivated reasoning is a related broad label, but the candidate does not use the benchmark's Incentive bias label. The candidate's own caveat appropriately leaves open a deliberate stakeholder-management trade-off.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate directly identifies the pending owner relationship, removal of safety margin, and incomplete disclosure of classification uncertainty, fully matching the hidden mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The candidate quote is exact and the proposed mechanism is strongly supported, while the candidate status correctly reflects ambiguity between cognitive bias and deliberate client-relationship management.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is localized correctly but identifies Confirmation bias, not Stereotyping, and its explanation focuses on confirmatory search rather than fully on category-based substitution for case-specific evidence.

The finding uses Anchoring bias as the label, but the quoted behavior and mechanism fully match the hidden Satisficing occurrence; it is therefore a mechanism-first recovery, not a strict label match.

The candidate is not an identified finding and proposes Motivated reasoning rather than Incentive bias. Its mechanism would match under the mechanism-first scorecard if candidate findings are admitted.

candidates.details: The candidate accurately identifies the relationship-driven recommendation and incomplete surfacing of classification uncertainty. It remains a candidate because the same account can be read as deliberate stakeholder management or a conflict-of-interest trade-off rather than an automatic cognitive distortion.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No low-confidence identified findings qualify; all three positive segments are missed and the negative commissioning segment is correctly rejected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: No low-confidence identified findings qualify; all three positive segments are missed and the negative commissioning segment is correctly rejected.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: The two low-confidence identified findings localize to two of three positive segments; the incentive-related segment is missed because its evidence remains a candidate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Adding the candidate tier detects the remaining positive segment without creating a detection on the negative commissioning segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Substantial overlap in reliance on prior tenant similarity and failure to obtain case-specific data, but the RAG mechanism is confirmatory search rather than category substitution.
Full overlap with stopping at the first minimally acceptable density/area point without comparing alternatives, despite the incorrect taxonomy label.
The candidate fully captures relationship-driven recommendation and incomplete disclosure of classification uncertainty.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: Both identified occurrences claim retrieved support and provide citation metadata, but the underlying passages and retrieval logs were not supplied, so those claims and citations are unverifiable. The candidate makes no retrieved-support claim. This audit does not alter detection or classification scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: both thresholds exclude all low-confidence identified findings and candidates.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The two low-confidence identified findings enter: segment hits rise from 0 to 2, while strict instance F1 remains 0 and mechanism-first instance F1 rises to 0.4.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The relationship-related candidate enters: segment hits rise from 2 to 3, strict instance F1 remains 0, and mechanism-first instance F1 rises from 0.4 to 0.6667.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects none of the positive segments because all identified findings are low confidence. At all identified confidence levels it detects 2 of 3 positive segments with no false alarms; admitting candidates detects all 3 positive segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No hidden occurrence receives a strict true positive. The run produces two correctly localized but wrongly labeled identified findings and one correctly localized but wrongly labeled candidate.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring recovers the density-selection Satisficing occurrence from the Anchoring-labeled finding and recovers the Incentive bias occurrence from the candidate, yielding F1 0.4 with identified findings and 0.6667 when candidates are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Useful: the candidate is a well-supported, correctly localized near miss whose mechanism matches the hidden Incentive bias, and admitting candidates adds one true positive without a negative-segment false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy substitutions: Confirmation bias for Stereotyping and Anchoring bias for Satisficing.
All identified findings are low confidence, so the recommended threshold produces no detections.
The incentive-related mechanism is left at candidate status and labeled Motivated reasoning rather than Incentive bias.
Retrieved-support claims cannot be independently verified from the supplied inputs.
main_strengths: All three predictions are localized to the correct decision episodes.
The identified findings and candidate use valid, faithful participant quotations.
The density-selection finding and value-engineering candidate capture the hidden mechanisms strongly.
The negative commissioning segment is correctly rejected at every threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong episode-level detection but weak strict taxonomy performance. Its mechanism-first performance is materially better, indicating that the main loss is label discrimination among neighboring constructs rather than failure to identify the relevant reasoning episodes.
